title: XRepoSkill: Learning Transferable Skills for Software Engineering Agents
title_zh: XRepoSkill: 学习软件工程代理的可转移技能

paragraphs.en: Software engineering agents increasingly use reusable skills distilled from prior experience to resolve repository-level issues, yet such skills often fail to transfer across repositories. A central challenge is that a behavior appearing in a successful trajectory is not necessarily responsible for the successful outcome: it may be genuinely useful, merely incidental, or simply a recurring habit of the model. We introduce XRepoSkill, a trajectory-based approach for learning transferable skills. We represent a skill as a collection of rules, each specifying what action to take and when to take it during issue resolution. XRepoSkill first contrasts successful and failed trajectories of the same agent on the same issue and derives candidate rules from where their execution paths diverge. Each rule is paired with an executable predicate that enables its prescribed behavior to be evaluated systematically on other trajectories. A rule is verified based on its association with successful issue resolution and retained only when its prescribed behavior recurs across multiple repositories; repository-specific variants of the same behavior are then consolidated into transferable rules. For a new issue, XRepoSkill selects relevant rules to guide the agent. We learn skills from publicly released trajectories on the official SWE-bench Verified leaderboard and evaluate them on SWE-bench Pro and DeepSWE using three backbone LLMs from different vendors; none of the evaluation repositories appears in the skill-learning trajectory pool. Against three recent skill learning methods, XRepoSkill achieves the highest issue resolution rate in all six benchmark–LLM combinations. In particular, on the challenging long-horizon DeepSWE benchmark, XRepoSkill improves issue resolution by 10.3 percentage points over the same agent without learned skills and by 5.0 points over the strongest skill-learning baseline.
paragraphs.zh: 软件工程智能体越来越多地使用从过往经验中提炼出的可复用技能来解决仓库级问题，但这些技能往往无法在不同仓库之间迁移。 一个核心挑战是：成功轨迹中出现的某种行为并不一定对成功结果负责——它可能确实有用，也可能只是偶然因素，甚至仅仅是模型反复出现的习惯。 我们提出了 XRepoSkill，一种基于轨迹的学习可迁移技能的方法。 我们将技能表示为一系列规则，每条规则都规定了在解决问题过程中应采取何种行动以及何时采取行动。 XRepoSkill 首先对比同一智能体在处理同一问题时的成功与失败轨迹，并从它们执行路径发生分歧的地方推导出候选规则。 每条规则都配有一个可执行的谓词，这使得其规定的行为能够被系统地评估到其他轨迹中。 一条规则会根据其与成功解决问题的关联得到验证，并且只有当它规定的行为在多个仓库中重复出现时才会被保留；随后，同一行为在不同仓库中的具体变体将被整合为可迁移的规则。 对于新问题，XRepoSkill 会选择相关规则来指导智能体。 我们从官方 SWE-bench Verified 排行榜上公开发布的轨迹中学习技能，并使用来自不同供应商的三种基础大语言模型在 SWE-bench Pro 和 DeepSWE 上进行评估；所有评估仓库均未出现在技能学习的轨迹池中。 在与三种近期技能学习方法的对比中，XRepoSkill 在所有六种基准与大型语言模型的组合中都实现了最高的问题解决率。 特别是在具有挑战性的长时程 DeepSWE 基准测试中，XRepoSkill 相比未学习技能的同一智能体，问题解决率提升了 10.3 个百分点；相比最强的技能学习基线方法，则提升了 5.0 个百分点。

paragraphs.en: Software engineering agents can resolve software issues by exploring a repository, modifying its code, running tests, and producing a patch ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2024 ) . One increasingly popular way to equip such agents with reusable expertise, without retraining the backbone LLM, is through skills ( Anthropic, 2026 ) : packages of task-specific knowledge and guidance loaded at inference time to steer agent behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 软件工程智能体可以通过探索代码库、修改其代码、运行测试和生成补丁来解决软件问题（Jimenez 等人，2024；Yang 等人，2024）。 一种日益流行的方法是为这类智能体赋予可重用的专业知识，而无需重新训练基础大语言模型，即通过技能（Anthropic，2026）：在推理时加载的特定任务知识和指导包，用以引导智能体的行为。

paragraphs.en: A central challenge, however, is that software engineering skills do not necessarily transfer across repositories. Recent work ( Han et al., 2026 ) shows that most public software engineering skills provide little or no improvement on real-world repositories, and some can even hurt performance when their guidance does not fit the target context. This context dependence raises a fundamental question for skill learning: which behaviors learned from past repositories will remain useful when the agent encounters a repository it has never seen before?
paragraphs.zh: 然而，一个核心挑战在于，软件工程技能并不一定能够跨仓库迁移。 近期的研究（Han 等人，2026）表明，大多数公开的软件工程技能对真实世界的仓库几乎没有提升作用，甚至当这些指导与目标上下文不匹配时，还会降低性能。 这种对上下文的依赖性引发了技能学习的一个根本问题：从过往仓库中学到的哪些行为，在智能体遇到一个从未见过的仓库时仍然会有用？

paragraphs.en: Recent work has begun to learn skills directly from agent trajectories, allowing agents to reuse experience from previous tasks. Trace2Skill ( Ni et al., 2026 ) , for example, extracts trajectory-local lessons and hierarchically consolidates recurring ones into a shared skill directory; and, specifically for software engineering, STAIR ( Xu et al., 2026 ) abstracts past repair trajectories into reusable actions and strategies that are retrieved and adapted for new issues. Yet observing a behavior in a successful trajectory does not by itself establish that the behavior is relevant to the successful outcome: it may be genuinely useful, merely incidental, or simply reflect a recurring habit of the backbone LLM. Moreover, even a useful behavior may depend on repository-specific conventions or workflows and fail to transfer elsewhere. This makes it difficult to determine which behaviors extracted from historical trajectories constitute genuinely reusable software engineering knowledge.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的研究已开始直接从智能体轨迹中学习技能，使智能体能够复用先前任务中的经验。 例如，Trace2Skill（Ni 等人，2026）会提取轨迹局部的经验，并将重复出现的经验分层整合到一个共享的技能目录中；而在软件工程领域，STAIR（Xu 等人，2026）则会将过往的修复轨迹抽象为可重用的动作和策略，以便在新问题出现时进行调取和适配。 然而，在成功轨迹中观察到某种行为本身并不能证明该行为与成功结果相关：它可能确实有用，也可能只是偶然发生，或者仅仅反映了底层大语言模型的习惯性操作。 此外，即使某种行为确实有用，它也可能依赖于特定代码库的惯例或工作流程，因而无法迁移到其他环境中。 这使得我们难以判断哪些从历史轨迹中提取的行为真正构成了可重用的软件工程知识。

paragraphs.en: To address this challenge, we propose XRepoSkill, a trajectory-based skill learning method that separates the discovery of potentially useful behaviors from their empirical verification. We represent a skill as a collection of rules, each specifying what action to take and when to take it during issue resolution. XRepoSkill first contrasts successful and failed trajectories produced by the same agent on the same issue with different backbone LLMs. Because the issue, repository, and agent are fixed, their shared behavior provides little evidence for explaining the different outcomes; XRepoSkill therefore localizes where the two execution paths first diverge and uses the subsequent behavioral differences to derive candidate rules. This comparison narrows rule discovery to behaviors that distinguish successful from unsuccessful attempts rather than indiscriminately summarizing everything that appears in a successful trajectory.
paragraphs.zh: 为应对这一挑战，我们提出了 XRepoSkill——一种基于轨迹的技能学习方法，它将潜在有用行为的发现与其经验验证分离开来。 我们将技能表示为一组规则的集合，每条规则都规定了在问题解决过程中应采取何种行动以及何时采取该行动。 XRepoSkill 首先对比同一智能体在处理同一问题时，使用不同基础大语言模型所生成的成功与失败轨迹。 由于问题、代码库和智能体都是固定的，它们共有的行为几乎无法解释结果差异；因此，XRepoSkill 会定位两条执行路径首次出现分歧的位置，并利用后续的行为差异推导出候选规则。 这种比较将规则发现的范围缩小到那些能够区分成功与失败尝试的行为上，而非盲目地总结成功轨迹中出现的每一个细节。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate XRepoSkill on the widely used SWE-bench Pro benchmark ( Deng et al., 2026 ) and the more challenging long-horizon DeepSWE benchmark ( Huang et al., 2026 ) using three backbone LLMs from different vendors. For skill learning, XRepoSkill uses publicly released trajectories from the official SWE-bench Verified leaderboard ( SWE-bench, 2026 ) . None of the repositories in either evaluation benchmark appears in this trajectory pool, ensuring that the evaluation directly measures transfer to previously unseen repositories. We use mini-SWE-agent ( Yang et al., 2024 ) as the underlying software engineering agent, a lightweight yet strong open-source framework that has been widely adopted as a research baseline and as the foundation for several recent software engineering agents ( Lee et al., 2026 ; Guo et al., 2026 ; Tripathy et al., 2026 ) . We compare XRepoSkill with three recently proposed skill learning methods under the same agent and trajectory setting.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用来自不同供应商的三种基础大语言模型，在广泛使用的 SWE-bench Pro 基准（Deng 等人，2026）和更具挑战性的长周期 DeepSWE 基准（Huang 等人，2026）上对 XRepoSkill 进行了评估。 在技能学习方面，XRepoSkill 使用了官方 SWE-bench Verified 排行榜（SWE-bench，2026）中公开发布的轨迹数据。 这两个评估基准中的任何代码库均未出现在该轨迹池中，从而确保评估能够直接衡量模型向此前未见的代码库的迁移能力。 我们将 mini-SWE-agent（Yang 等人，2024）用作底层的软件工程智能体，这是一个轻量但强大的开源框架，已被广泛用作研究基线以及近期多个软件工程智能体的基础（Lee 等人，2026；Guo 等人，2026；Tripathy 等人，2026）。 我们在相同的智能体和轨迹设置下，将 XRepoSkill 与三种近期提出的技能学习方法进行了比较。

sents.en: For skill learning, XRepoSkill uses publicly released trajectories from the official SWE-bench Verified leaderboard ( SWE-bench, 2026 ) .

sents.en: None of the repositories in either evaluation benchmark appears in this trajectory pool, ensuring that the evaluation directly measures transfer to previously unseen repositories.
sents.zh: 这两个评估基准中的任何代码库均未出现在该轨迹池中，从而确保评估能够直接衡量模型向此前未见的代码库的迁移能力。

sents.en: We use mini-SWE-agent ( Yang et al., 2024 ) as the underlying software engineering agent, a lightweight yet strong open-source framework that has been widely adopted as a research baseline and as the foundation for several recent software engineering agents ( Lee et al., 2026 ; Guo et al., 2026 ; Tripathy et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 我们将 mini-SWE-agent（Yang 等人，2024）用作底层的软件工程智能体，这是一个轻量但强大的开源框架，已被广泛用作研究基线以及近期多个软件工程智能体的基础（Lee 等人，2026；Guo 等人，2026；Tripathy 等人，2026）。

sents.en: We compare XRepoSkill with three recently proposed skill learning methods under the same agent and trajectory setting.
sents.zh: 我们在相同的智能体和轨迹设置下，将 XRepoSkill 与三种近期提出的技能学习方法进行了比较。

paragraphs.en: Across all six benchmark–LLM combinations, XRepoSkill consistently achieves the highest issue resolution rate. In particular, on the more challenging long-horizon DeepSWE benchmark, XRepoSkill improves issue resolution by 10.3 percentage points over the same agent without learned skills and by 5.0 points over the strongest skill learning baseline. The learned skill also transfers beyond the programming language represented during skill learning: although all source trajectories come from Python repositories, XRepoSkill achieves clear improvements on issues written in other programming languages. These results indicate that XRepoSkill distills transferable issue-resolution guidance rather than repository- or language-specific patterns.
paragraphs.zh: 在所有六种基准–大型语言模型组合中，XRepoSkill始终实现了最高的问题解决率。 特别是在更具挑战性的长期规划DeepSWE基准测试中，XRepoSkill的问题解决能力比未学习技能的同一智能体提升了10.3个百分点，比最强的技能学习基线模型提升了5.0个百分点。 所学到的技能还能迁移到技能学习阶段未涉及的编程语言：尽管所有源轨迹均来自Python仓库，但XRepoSkill在编写于其他编程语言的问题上仍实现了显著改进。 这些结果表明，XRepoSkill提炼的是可迁移的问题解决指导，而非特定于仓库或语言的模式。

paragraphs.en: In summary, this paper makes the following contributions:
paragraphs.zh: 总而言之，本文做出了以下贡献：

paragraphs.en: We introduce XRepoSkill, a trajectory-based skill learning approach that discovers candidate rules from behavioral divergences between successful and failed attempts, verifies them on independent trajectory evidence, and retains only behaviors recurring across repositories as transferable rules.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 XRepoSkill，这是一种基于轨迹的技能学习方法。该方法从成功尝试与失败尝试之间的行为差异中挖掘候选规则，在独立的轨迹证据上对其进行验证，并仅保留那些在不同知识库中反复出现的行为作为可迁移的规则。

paragraphs.en: We extensively evaluate XRepoSkill against recent skill learning methods on SWE-bench Pro and DeepSWE, showing the highest issue resolution rate in all evaluated benchmark–LLM combinations and strong transfer to previously unseen repositories and programming languages.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 SWE-bench Pro 和 DeepSWE 上对 XRepoSkill 与近期的技能学习方法进行了全面评估，结果表明，在所有评估的基准–大语言模型组合中，XRepoSkill 展现出最高的问题解决率，并且能够有效地迁移到此前未见的代码库和编程语言。

paragraphs.en: We publicly release our code and data at https://github.com/XREPOSKILL/XRepoSkill .
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 https://github.com/XREPOSKILL/XRepoSkill 上公开发布了我们的代码和数据。

paragraphs.en: We consider a software engineering agent A A and a trajectory pool 𝒯 \mathcal{T} that records its attempts to resolve historical software issues using different backbone LLMs. Each trajectory contains the agent’s sequence of actions and observations during one issue-resolution attempt, and 𝒯 \mathcal{T} includes both successful and failed trajectories.
paragraphs.zh: 我们考虑一个软件工程智能体 A 和一个轨迹池 𝒯 \mathcal{T}，该轨迹池记录了它使用不同基础 LLM 解决历史软件问题的尝试。 每条轨迹都包含智能体在一次问题解决尝试中的动作与观察序列，而 𝒯 \mathcal{T} 既包括成功的轨迹，也包括失败的轨迹。

paragraphs.en: From 𝒯 \mathcal{T} , we seek to learn a transferable skill S S . S S consists of a collection of rules, each providing reusable guidance on what action to take and when to take it during issue resolution. We intend the learned skill to support future issues from repositories that do not appear in the trajectory pool.

Our goal is for the resulting skill-guided agent to achieve a higher issue resolution rate on previously unseen repositories than the original agent without the learned skill.

paragraphs.en: Figure 1 presents an overview of XRepoSkill. Given the trajectory pool 𝒯 \mathcal{T} of the software engineering agent A A , XRepoSkill distills a transferable skill S S and applies it to a new issue i ⋆ i^{\star} . XRepoSkill consists of three stages. First, Divergence-Guided Rule Discovery (Section 2.3 ) compares successful and failed trajectories of A A on the same issue, identifies where their execution paths first diverge, and turns the divergent actions into candidate rules. Second, Rule Verification and Cross-Repository Generalization (Section 2.4 ) evaluates each candidate rule on other trajectories to determine whether trajectories that perform its prescribed action resolve issues more often than those that do not. It then consolidates rules from different repositories that capture the same underlying behavior into transferable rules, forming the skill S S . Third, Issue-Adaptive Rule Selection (Section 2.5 ) selects rules relevant to i ⋆ i^{\star} from S S and provides them as guidance to the agent A A .
paragraphs.zh: 图 1 展示了 XRepoSkill 的概览。 给定软件工程智能体 A 的轨迹池 𝒯 \mathcal{T}，XRepoSkill 会提炼出一种可迁移的技能 S，并将其应用于新问题 i ⋆ i^{\star}。 XRepoSkill 包含三个阶段。 首先，分歧引导规则发现（第 2.3 节）会对比智能体 A 在相同问题上成功与失败的轨迹，识别其执行路径首次发生分歧的位置，并将这些分歧动作转化为候选规则。 其次，规则验证与跨仓库泛化（第 2.4 节）会在其他轨迹上评估每条候选规则，以判断执行其规定动作的轨迹是否比未执行该动作的轨迹更频繁地解决问题。 随后，它会将来自不同仓库、但捕捉到相同底层行为的规则整合为可迁移的规则，从而形成技能 S。 最后，问题自适应规则选择（第 2.5 节）会从 S 中挑选与 i ⋆ i^{\star} 相关的规则，并将其作为指导提供给智能体 A。

paragraphs.en: The goal of this stage is to discover candidate rules from behavioral differences between successful and failed attempts on the same issue. For each issue in 𝒯 \mathcal{T} with both outcomes, XRepoSkill pairs a successful trajectory with a failed trajectory produced by the same agent A A under different backbone LLMs. Because the issue, repository, and agent are fixed, behaviors shared by the two trajectories cannot explain their different outcomes. XRepoSkill therefore aligns the trajectories, identifies where their execution paths first meaningfully diverge, and uses the subsequent behavioral differences to derive candidate rules. At this stage, these rules are only hypotheses; whether they are consistently associated with successful issue resolution is examined in Stage 2.
paragraphs.zh: 本阶段的目标是从同一问题上成功尝试与失败尝试之间的行为差异中，发现候选规则。 对于 𝒯 \mathcal{T} 中同时具有两种结果的每个问题，XRepoSkill 会将一个成功轨迹与由同一智能体 A 在不同基础 LLM 下产生的失败轨迹进行配对。 由于问题、代码库和智能体都是固定的，两个轨迹共有的行为无法解释它们结果的不同。 因此，XRepoSkill 会对齐这些轨迹，识别其执行路径首次出现有意义的分歧之处，并利用后续的行为差异推导出候选规则。 在此阶段，这些规则仅为假设；它们是否与成功解决问题存在稳定关联，将在第 2 阶段进行检验。

paragraphs.en: It is unreliable to directly compare raw trajectories because the same behavior may be expressed through different tool calls. Thus, XRepoSkill maps each tool call to an abstract action defined by its type (e.g., reading a file, searching, editing, or running tests) and target (i.e., the object on which the call operates). For example, different commands that read the same file are mapped to the same abstract action. Each trajectory is thereby transformed into an action sequence, allowing behaviorally equivalent steps to be aligned despite differences in their concrete realization.
paragraphs.zh: 直接比较原始轨迹并不可靠，因为相同的行为可能通过不同的工具调用来表达。 因此，XRepoSkill 将每个工具调用映射到一个由其类型（例如，读取文件、搜索、编辑或运行测试）和目标（即该调用所操作的对象）定义的抽象动作。 例如，读取同一文件的不同命令会被映射到相同的抽象动作。 这样，每条轨迹就被转换成一个动作序列，使得行为上等价的步骤能够对齐，尽管它们的具體实现方式不同。

paragraphs.en: XRepoSkill aligns the two action sequences from the beginning and identifies the first point at which their behaviors meaningfully differ. Two actions match when they have the same type and target. Differences in the ordering of information-gathering actions, such as reading and searching, are tolerated because they may reflect different exploration orders rather than different resolution strategies. In contrast, an unmatched action that materially changes the subsequent course of the attempt, such as editing code or running a test, terminates the shared prefix. We define the first action after this shared prefix as the divergence point. The divergence point serves as an anchor for rule discovery: actions before it are shared by both the successful and failed attempts and therefore provide little evidence for explaining their different outcomes, whereas the behavior after it contains decisions unique to one execution path and thus provides a more informative search space for candidate rules. XRepoSkill retains the shared prefix in condensed form together with the two trajectory suffixes beginning at the divergence point for rule generation.
paragraphs.zh: XRepoSkill 从起始处对齐两个动作序列，并确定其行为首次出现有意义的差异的位置。 当两个动作的类型和目标相同时，它们被视为匹配。 信息收集动作（如读取和搜索）的顺序差异会被容忍，因为这些差异可能反映不同的探索顺序，而非不同的解决策略。 相比之下，任何不匹配且实质性改变后续尝试进程的动作（如编辑代码或运行测试）都会终止共享前缀。 我们将共享前缀之后的第一个动作定义为分歧点。 分歧点为规则发现提供了锚点：在此之前的动作是成功和失败尝试所共有的，因此对解释其不同结果提供的证据有限；而此后的行为则包含某一执行路径独有的决策，从而为候选规则提供了更具信息量的搜索空间。 XRepoSkill 以压缩形式保留共享前缀，并连同始于分歧点的两条轨迹后缀一起用于生成规则。

paragraphs.en: The first divergence is not necessarily the behavior most relevant to the final outcome: once the trajectories separate, useful actions may occur later in the successful execution path. Rather than comparing the two suffixes step by step after the divergence point, XRepoSkill extracts candidate rules from three complementary reference points that remain well-defined without step-by-step alignment. The first examines the failed trajectory in light of the successful patch to identify information that may have helped the failed attempt. The second examines the successful trajectory to identify useful information-gathering and validation performed before editing. The third focuses on the divergence point itself and asks what the successful attempt does that the failed one does not. Each identified behavior is converted into a candidate rule specifying both what action to take and when to take it , and is phrased to apply beyond the specific issue from which it was extracted. The resulting candidate rules are passed to Stage 2.

paragraphs.en: Candidate rules are written in natural language, making repeated evaluation over extensive trajectories with LLM calls both expensive and potentially inconsistent. The predicate is defined over the abstract actions from Stage 1 and captures the behavior prescribed by the rule, including whether an action occurs, whether one action precedes another, or how often an action occurs. For instance, the rule “run the failing test before editing any file” is represented by the predicate before ⁡ ( run ​ _ ​ test , first ​ _ ​ edit ) \mathrm{before}(\mathrm{run\_test},\mathrm{first\_edit}) . paragraphs.en: We use publicly released trajectories from the official SWE-bench Verified leaderboard ( SWE-bench, 2026 ) as the source data for skill learning. These trajectories are generated by running mini-SWE-agent 2.0 (hereafter, mini-SWE-agent) on SWE-bench Verified ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) , a widely used issue-resolution benchmark comprising 500 real-world, human-validated Python issues. mini-SWE-agent is a lightweight yet strong open-source agent that is widely adopted as a research baseline ( Lee et al., 2026 ; Guo et al., 2026 ; Tripathy et al., 2026 ) . The leaderboard includes trajectories produced with 12 backbone LLMs: Claude Haiku 4.5, Claude Sonnet 4.5, Claude Opus 4.5, Claude Opus 4.6, DeepSeek-V3.2, Gemini 3 Flash, Gemini 3 Pro, GLM-5, GPT-5.2, GPT-5 mini, Kimi K2.5, and MiniMax M2.5. Together, these runs yield a trajectory pool with 12 pass- or fail-labeled trajectories per issue.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将官方 SWE-bench Verified 排行榜（SWE-bench，2026）中公开发布的轨迹用作技能学习的源数据。 这些轨迹是通过在 SWE-bench Verified（Jimenez 等人，2024）上运行 mini-SWE-agent 2.0（下文称为 mini-SWE-agent）生成的。SWE-bench Verified 是一个广泛使用的故障解决基准测试，包含 500 个经过人类验证的真实世界 Python 问题。mini-SWE-agent 是一款轻量但强大的开源智能体，被广泛用作研究基线（Lee 等人，2026；Guo 等人，2026；Tripathy 等人，2026）。 该排行榜包含了使用 12 款基础大语言模型生成的轨迹：Claude Haiku 4.5、Claude Sonnet 4.5、Claude Opus 4.5、Claude Opus 4.6、DeepSeek-V3.2、Gemini 3 Flash、Gemini 3 Pro、GLM-5、GPT-5.2、GPT-5 mini、Kimi K2.5 和 MiniMax M2.5。 这些运行共同构成了一个轨迹池，其中每个问题都包含 12 条标记为通过或失败的轨迹。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate XRepoSkill on two recently introduced benchmarks, SWE-bench Pro ( Deng et al., 2026 ) and DeepSWE ( Huang et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 我们在两个近期推出的基准数据集上对 XRepoSkill 进行了评估，即 SWE-bench Pro（Deng 等人，2026）和 DeepSWE（Huang 等人，2026）。

paragraphs.en: SWE-bench Pro contains 731 issue resolution tasks from 11 open-source repositories spanning Python, Go, JavaScript, and TypeScript. Due to budget constraints, we randomly sample 200 tasks for evaluation, comprising 69 Python, 73 Go, 52 JavaScript, and 6 TypeScript tasks.
paragraphs.zh: SWE-bench Pro 包含来自 11 个开源仓库的 731 个问题解决任务，这些仓库涵盖了 Python、Go、JavaScript 和 TypeScript。 由于预算限制，我们随机抽取了 200 个任务进行评估，其中包括 69 个 Python 任务、73 个 Go 任务、52 个 JavaScript 任务和 6 个 TypeScript 任务。

paragraphs.en: We have confirmed that none of the repositories in either benchmark appears in our trajectory pool, ensuring that the evaluation measures transfer to previously unseen repositories.
paragraphs.zh: 我们已经确认，两个基准测试中的任何仓库均未出现在我们的轨迹池中，从而确保了评估结果能够迁移到此前未见的仓库。

paragraphs.en: We use the resolution rate ( %Resolved ) as the evaluation metric, defined as the proportion of benchmark issues resolved by an agent.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将解决率（%Resolved）用作评估指标，其定义为智能体所解决的基准问题所占的比例。

paragraphs.en: Besides the raw mini-SWE-agent without any skills, we compare XRepoSkill with three representative trajectory-based skill-learning methods:
paragraphs.zh: 除了没有任何技能的原始 mini-SWE-agent 之外，我们还将 XRepoSkill 与三种具有代表性的基于轨迹的技能学习方法进行了比较：

paragraphs.en: SkillOpt ( Yang et al., 2026 ) treats the skill document as a trainable state of an agent and iteratively updates it from scored trajectories, retaining only changes that improve held-out performance.
paragraphs.zh: SkillOpt（Yang 等人，2026）将技能文档视为智能体的一个可训练状态，并通过评分后的轨迹对其进行迭代更新，仅保留能够提升预留集表现的变化。

paragraphs.en: STAIR ( Xu et al., 2026 ) abstracts past repair trajectories into reusable actions and strategies, then retrieves and adapts relevant experience into an issue-specific plan for each new task.
paragraphs.zh: STAIR（Xu 等人，2026）将过往的修复轨迹抽象为可重用的动作和策略，然后检索并调整相关经验，为每个新任务生成针对具体问题的计划。

paragraphs.en: Trace2Skill ( Ni et al., 2026 ) distills trajectory-local lessons in parallel and hierarchically consolidates them into a shared transferable skill directory used at inference time.
paragraphs.zh: Trace2Skill（Ni 等人，2026）以并行方式提炼轨迹局部经验，并分层整合这些经验，形成一个在推理阶段使用的共享可迁移技能目录。

paragraphs.en: To ensure a fair comparison, we use the same LLM, DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813, for XRepoSkill and all baseline methods to learn skills from the same trajectory pool.
paragraphs.zh: 为确保公平比较，我们使用相同的 LLM（DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813）为 XRepoSkill 和所有基线方法学习技能，且所有方法均从同一个轨迹池中学习。

paragraphs.en: For issue resolution, we run all methods with the same mini-SWE-agent and evaluate each with three backbone LLMs from different vendors: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731, GPT-5.6-Luna, and MiMo-V2.5-Pro, hereafter referred to as DeepSeek , GPT , and MiMo . We set the reasoning effort to high for all three models, as issue resolution requires reasoning over the issue description, repository context, and tool outputs before making code edits.
paragraphs.zh: 在问题修复方面，我们使用相同的 mini-SWE-agent 运行所有方法，并使用来自不同供应商的三种基础大语言模型（LLM）对每种方法进行评估：DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731、GPT-5.6-Luna 和 MiMo-V2.5-Pro，下文分别简称为 DeepSeek、GPT 和 MiMo。 我们将所有三种模型的推理强度设为高，因为问题修复需要在进行代码编辑之前，对问题描述、仓库上下文和工具输出进行综合推理。

paragraphs.en: RQ1 evaluates the effectiveness of XRepoSkill in resolving issues from previously unseen repositories. Table 1 reports the resolution rates of XRepoSkill and the baselines across three backbone LLMs on SWE-bench Pro and DeepSWE. XRepoSkill achieves the highest resolution rate in all six benchmark–LLM combinations. This consistency is notable because the strongest baseline varies across benchmarks: on average, STAIR performs best on SWE-bench Pro, whereas Trace2Skill is strongest on DeepSWE. In contrast, XRepoSkill remains the top-performing method across both benchmarks and all three LLMs, demonstrating more consistent effectiveness than existing skill-learning methods.
paragraphs.zh: RQ1 评估了 XRepoSkill 在解决来自前所未见仓库的问题方面的有效性。 表 1 报告了 XRepoSkill 和基线方法在三种主干 LLM 上针对 SWE-bench Pro 和 DeepSWE 的解决率。 在所有六种基准-LLM 组合中，XRepoSkill 都实现了最高的解决率。 这种一致性值得注意，因为最强的基线方法在不同基准中有所不同：平均而言，STAIR 在 SWE-bench Pro 上表现最佳，而 Trace2Skill 在 DeepSWE 上最强。 相比之下，XRepoSkill 在这两个基准和所有三种 LLM 中始终是最优方法，显示出比现有技能学习方法更一致的有效性。

paragraphs.en: RQ3 examines whether the effectiveness of XRepoSkill remains stable across repeated runs. In this RQ, we focus on DeepSWE, whose long-horizon tasks make repeated-run stability particularly relevant, and compare XRepoSkill with the raw mini-SWE-agent without learned skills and with Trace2Skill, the strongest baseline on DeepSWE in RQ1. Given the computational cost of repeated evaluation and our limited budget, we use DeepSeek as the backbone LLM. Following the DeepSWE evaluation protocol, we run each method four times on all tasks and report the mean resolution rate with its 95% confidence interval. We further report Pass@4 and All@4, the proportions of issues resolved in at least one and in all four runs, respectively.
paragraphs.zh: RQ3 旨在探究 XRepoSkill 的有效性在重复运行中是否保持稳定。 在本研究问题中，我们重点关注 DeepSWE，其长期任务使得重复运行的稳定性尤为关键，并将 XRepoSkill 与未学习技能的原始 mini-SWE-agent 以及在 RQ1 中 DeepSWE 上表现最强的基线模型 Trace2Skill 进行比较。 鉴于重复评估的计算成本以及我们有限的预算，我们使用 DeepSeek 作为基础 LLM。 遵循 DeepSWE 的评估协议，我们在所有任务上对每种方法运行四次，并报告其平均解决率及 95% 置信区间。 我们还进一步报告了 Pass@4 和 All@4，分别表示在至少一次和全部四次运行中成功解决的问题比例。

paragraphs.en: RQ4 evaluates the key design choices in XRepoSkill. As in RQ3, we conduct the ablation study on DeepSWE with DeepSeek as the backbone LLM. We construct five variants spanning rule discovery, within-repository verification, cross-repository generalization, and rule selection. Each variant modifies only the designated component while keeping the rest of the pipeline unchanged: (1) w/ Trace2Skill replaces the candidate rules discovered in Stage 1 with rules generated by Trace2Skill; (2) w/o within-repo removes within-repository rule verification and directly passes rules to cross-repository consolidation; (3) w/o cross-repo removes cross-repository consolidation and retains the independently verified repository-level rules; (4) w/ all rules provides the full rule set to the agent instead of selecting relevant rules in Stage 3; and (5) w/o evidence removes the historical evidence associated with each rule from the Stage 3 selection process.
paragraphs.zh: RQ4 评估了 XRepoSkill 中的关键设计选择。 与 RQ3 类似，我们在 DeepSWE 上进行了消融研究，其中 DeepSeek 作为基础 LLM。 我们构建了五个变体，涵盖规则发现、库内验证、跨库泛化和规则选择。 每个变体仅修改指定的组件，同时保持流程其余部分不变：(1) w/ Trace2Skill 用 Trace2Skill 生成的规则替换第一阶段发现的候选规则；(2) w/o within-repo 移除库内规则验证，并将规则直接传递给跨库整合模块；(3) w/o cross-repo 移除跨库整合模块，保留独立验证的库级规则；(4) w/ all rules 将完整的规则集提供给智能体，而不是在第三阶段选择相关规则；以及 (5) w/o evidence 从第三阶段的规则选择过程中移除与每条规则相关的历史证据。

paragraphs.en: Table 4 reports the results. Each ablation variant degrades the performance of XRepoSkill, suggesting that its gains do not stem from a single component but from the combined contributions of rule discovery, verification, cross-repository generalization, and rule selection. The largest drop comes from replacing issue-adaptive selection with all rules (58.4% → \rightarrow 48.7%), followed by removing cross-repository generalization (51.3%) and removing within-repository verification (53.1%). These results highlight the importance of verifying rules and consolidating behaviors recurring across repositories before inference and selecting only rules relevant to the current issue. Replacing divergence-guided discovery with Trace2Skill reduces the resolution rate to 54.9%, suggesting that the source of candidate rules also matters, while removing rule evidence lowers performance to 55.8%, suggesting that historical support helps the selector prioritize useful guidance.

paragraphs.en: Software engineering agents primarily target repository-level issue resolution. SWE-bench ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) established this setting as a standard benchmark and spurred rapid progress in systems such as SWE-agent ( Yang et al., 2024 ) , OpenHands ( Wang et al., 2025a ) , AutoCodeRover ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) , and Agentless ( Xia et al., 2025a ) . mini-SWE-agent provides a lightweight, shell-based implementation of this workflow and has become a widely used open-source research baseline, with several recent agents building on it ( Guo et al., 2026 ; Xia et al., 2025b ) . Subsequent work has further improved issue-resolution performance through stronger search and planning, multi-agent collaboration, and test-time scaling ( Tao et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Gao et al., 2025 ; Ehrlich et al., 2025 ) . Our work studies skill learning in the same setting using mini-SWE-agent as the underlying agent, while keeping the agent itself unchanged so that performance differences reflect the skills rather than changes to the agent architecture.
paragraphs.zh: 软件工程智能体主要致力于仓库级别的issue解决。 SWE-bench（Jimenez等，2024）将这一场景确立为标准基准，并推动了SWE-agent（Yang等，2024）、OpenHands（Wang等，2025a）、AutoCodeRover（Zhang等，2024）和Agentless（Xia等，2025a）等系统的快速发展。mini-SWE-agent为此工作流程提供了一种轻量级的基于命令行的实现，并已成为广泛使用的开源研究基准，近期有多款智能体在此基础上进行了改进（Guo等，2026；Xia等，2025b）。 后续研究通过更强的搜索与规划、多智能体协作以及测试时的扩展能力，进一步提升了issue解决性能（Tao等，2024；Zhang等，2025；Gao等，2025；Ehrlich等，2025）。 我们的研究在同一场景下探讨了技能学习问题，使用mini-SWE-agent作为基础智能体，同时保持智能体本身不变，以确保性能差异反映的是技能水平，而非智能体架构的变化。

paragraphs.en: Skills provide agents with reusable task guidance at inference time. Their effectiveness, however, depends strongly on how they are constructed ( Han et al., 2026 ) . A growing body of work distills reusable skills from agent trajectories, including executable programs, natural-language experience, workflows, and skill documents ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Zheng et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2024 ; Ouyang et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2025b ) . Among recent skill-learning methods, SkillOpt ( Yang et al., 2026 ) optimizes skills against validation performance, while Trace2Skill ( Ni et al., 2026 ) consolidates recurring trajectory-local lessons into transferable skills. In software engineering specifically, STAIR ( Xu et al., 2026 ) abstracts repair trajectories into reusable plans for new issues. XRepoSkill differs by explicitly verifying candidate rules on trajectories beyond those from which they are discovered and retaining them as transferable only when the same behavior recurs across repositories.
paragraphs.zh: 技能在推理时为智能体提供可重复使用的任务指导。 然而，其有效性在很大程度上取决于技能的构建方式（Han et al., 2026）。 越来越多的研究从智能体轨迹中提炼出可重复使用的技能，包括可执行程序、自然语言经验、工作流和技能文档（Wang et al., 2024；Zheng et al., 2025；Zhao et al., 2024；Ouyang et al., 2026；Wang et al., 2025b）。 在近期的技能学习方法中，SkillOpt（Yang et al., 2026）通过验证性能来优化技能，而Trace2Skill（Ni et al., 2026）则将重复出现的局部轨迹经验整合为可迁移的技能。 特别是在软件工程领域，STAIR（Xu et al., 2026）将修复轨迹抽象为可用于新问题的可重复使用计划。 XRepoSkill的不同之处在于，它明确地在发现这些规则所依据的轨迹之外进行验证，并且只有当相同的行为在不同代码库中反复出现时，才会保留这些规则作为可迁移的技能。

paragraphs.en: This paper studies how to learn software engineering skills that remain useful beyond the repositories from which they are distilled. We introduce XRepoSkill, a trajectory-based skill learning approach that contrasts successful and failed attempts to discover candidate rules, verifies their prescribed behaviors on independent trajectories through executable predicates, and retains only rules independently verified across repositories as transferable guidance. Evaluated on SWE-bench Pro and DeepSWE with three backbone LLMs, XRepoSkill consistently achieves the highest issue resolution rate in all six benchmark–LLM combinations, compared with both the underlying agent without learned skills and recent skill-learning baselines. These results highlight the value of going beyond extracting recurring behaviors from past experience by testing candidate behaviors against broader trajectory evidence and validating them beyond their original repository context.
paragraphs.zh: 本文研究了如何学习那些在提取自原始代码库之后仍然有用的软件工程技能。 我们提出了 XRepoSkill，一种基于轨迹的技能学习方法：它通过对比成功与失败的尝试来发现候选规则，利用可执行谓词在独立轨迹上验证这些规则所规定的行为，并仅保留经过跨代码库独立验证的规则作为可迁移的指导。 在 SWE-bench Pro 和 DeepSWE 数据集上，结合三种基础大语言模型对 XRepoSkill 进行评估的结果显示，在所有六种基准与语言模型的组合中，该方法始终实现了最高的问题解决率，优于未学习技能的底层智能体以及近期的技能学习基线方法。 这些结果凸显了超越从过往经验中提取重复行为的重要性——即通过将候选行为与更广泛的轨迹证据进行对比测试，并在其原始代码库环境之外进行验证。

paragraphs.en: Backbone LLMs are ranked by their resolution rate on the trajectory pool. On each issue with both successful and failed trajectories, every failed trajectory is combined with every successful trajectory from a backbone LLM with a higher resolution rate, the combinations are ranked by the gap in resolution rate between the two LLMs, and the top four become pairs. A check before pairing asserts that no issue of the pool appears in either evaluation benchmark.
paragraphs.zh: 骨干 LLM 的排名依据是它们在轨迹池中的解决率。 对于每个同时包含成功和失败轨迹的问题，每条失败轨迹都会与来自解决率更高的骨干 LLM 的每条成功轨迹进行组合；这些组合按照两个 LLM 之间解决率的差距进行排序，排名前四的组合将成为配对。 在配对之前，会进行一项检查，以确保池中的任何问题均未出现在任一评估基准中。

paragraphs.en: Before a tool call is mapped to an abstract action, compound commands joined by && or ; are split into one command each, and leading cd , environment variable assignments, and timeout prefixes are stripped. A bare cd , pwd , or export yields no action. The type of the action is then decided by the program that leads the command. A read prints part of a file with cat , head , tail , less , nl , sed -n , or awk ; its target is the first file path in the command. A search runs grep , rg , ack , find , ls , which , locate , or tree ; its target is the quoted pattern, or the first non-option argument when nothing is quoted. An edit runs sed -i , redirects the output of cat , echo , printf , or tee into a source or configuration file, or runs patch or git apply ; its target is the written file. A test run invokes pytest , tox , python -m pytest , python -m unittest , or a runtests.py script; its target is the first argument containing “test”. A script run invokes python or ipython for anything other than a test run; its target is the first file path. An install runs pip , conda , or apt ; its target is the package name. A git action is any other git subcommand, with the subcommand as target. A submission is the final-output marker of mini-SWE-agent. Every remaining command is of type other, with an empty target. A regular expression in a predicate is matched case-insensitively against the full command text before splitting and stripping.
paragraphs.zh: 在将工具调用映射到抽象动作之前，由 && 或 ; 连接的复合命令会被拆分为单个命令，并且开头的 cd、环境变量赋值和超时前缀会被剥离。 单独的 cd、pwd 或 export 不会产生任何动作。 随后，动作的类型由命令开头的程序决定。 read 动作会使用 cat、head、tail、less、nl、sed -n 或 awk 打印文件的一部分；其目标是命令中的第一个文件路径。 search 动作会运行 grep、rg、ack、find、ls、which、locate 或 tree；其目标是带引号的模式，或者在没有带引号内容时第一个非选项参数。 edit 动作会运行 sed -i，将 cat、echo、printf 或 tee 的输出重定向到源文件或配置文件，或者运行 patch 或 git apply；其目标是写入的文件。 test run 动作会调用 pytest、tox、python -m pytest、python -m unittest 或 runtests.py 脚本；其目标是包含“test”的第一个参数。 script run 动作会在非测试运行的情况下调用 python 或 ipython；其目标是第一个文件路径。 install 动作会运行 pip、conda 或 apt；其目标是包名。 git 动作是任何其他 git 子命令，其目标为该子命令本身。 submission 是 mini-SWE-agent 的最终输出标记。 所有其余命令的类型均为 other，且目标为空。 谓词中的正则表达式会在拆分和剥离之前，与完整的命令文本进行不区分大小写的匹配。

paragraphs.en: The shared prefix is extended across matching blocks of the two action sequences. A gap of unmatched actions between two matching blocks is tolerated only if it holds at most three actions on each side and none of them is an edit, a test run, a script run, an install, or a submission. The text handed to the skill-learning LLM contains the shared prefix as a compact list of actions, the two trajectory suffixes from the divergence point onward within a fixed character budget, a compact list of the actions that follow the budget, and the position of every command in its trajectory, so that a prompt can cite a command by position.
paragraphs.zh: 共享前缀会扩展到两个动作序列中相匹配的区块。 只有当两个相匹配区块之间的未匹配动作间隙每侧最多包含三个动作，且这些动作中没有一个是编辑、测试运行、脚本运行、安装或提交时，该间隙才会被允许。 提供给技能学习 LLM 的文本包含共享前缀（以紧凑的动作列表形式）、从分歧点开始的两条轨迹后缀（在固定的字符限制内）、超出该限制后的动作紧凑列表，以及每条轨迹中每个命令的位置，以便提示可以通过位置引用某个命令。

paragraphs.en: Each pair is read by three prompts, one per reference point of Section 2.3 , and each prompt sees the text described above and nothing else from the trajectories. The first prompt reads the failed suffix together with the patch that the successful trajectory submitted and reports the earliest step that the failed trajectory skipped. The second reads the successful suffix only and reports up to three steps taken before its first edit. The third reads both suffixes and reports the earliest step that only the successful trajectory took, citing one command position on each side. The first and third prompts return one candidate rule each and the second returns one to three, so each pair yields three to five candidate rules. Each candidate rule is returned as a JSON object with a paragraph of at most 1,000 characters, a category, one of lookup, verification, replay, or search recipe, the trajectory identifiers and command positions it cites as evidence, and its executable predicate. A candidate rule that states a fact about the code instead of prescribing an action carries no predicate and must name at least one real file path or symbol; such rules cannot be verified in Stage 2 and never enter the transferable skill.
paragraphs.zh: 每对样本都由三个提示读取，每个提示对应第 2.3 节的一个参考点，且每个提示仅能看到上述描述中的文本，以及轨迹中的其他任何内容。 第一个提示会读取失败的后缀以及成功轨迹提交的补丁，并报告失败轨迹跳过的最早步骤。 第二个提示仅读取成功的后缀，并报告在其首次编辑之前执行的最多三个步骤。 第三个提示同时读取两个后缀，并报告只有成功轨迹所执行的最早步骤，同时引用其两侧的一个命令位置。 第一个和第三个提示各返回一条候选规则，而第二个提示返回一到三条，因此每对样本会产生三条到五条候选规则。 每条候选规则都以 JSON 对象的形式返回，其中包含一个最多 1,000 个字符的段落、一个类别（lookup、verification、replay 或 search recipe）、其作为证据引用的轨迹标识符和命令位置，以及其可执行的谓词。 如果候选规则陈述的是关于代码的事实而非规定动作，则不包含任何谓词，且必须至少命名一个真实的文件路径或符号；此类规则无法在阶段 2 中验证，也永远不会进入可转移技能库。

paragraphs.en: A candidate rule is rejected if its paragraph exceeds the length limit, if it prescribes an action and contains a file path followed by a line number or three or more rare symbols such as double-underscore method names, if its predicate does not parse, or if its predicate is true on fewer than 10% or more than 90% of the trajectories of the pool. paragraphs.en: Within a repository, candidate rules of the same category are handed to the skill-learning LLM in batches, and each batch is merged into between 3 and 10 rules; rules with the same title from different batches are merged again. The number of candidate rules merged into a rule is its support, and the predicate is also selected by the LLM. The prompt requires that exact commands, search patterns, and paths present in the candidate rules be kept verbatim, and rejects a merged rule reduced to advice such as “reproduce first”. A screen by the skill-learning LLM drops a merged rule only if it neither prescribes an action nor states a fact anchored to a file path or symbol, or if it contradicts conventions already recorded for its repository. An n-gram audit flags any rule whose text shares six or more consecutive tokens with the reference patch of one of its source issues.
paragraphs.zh: 在某个仓库中，同一类别的候选规则会分批次交给技能学习 LLM，每批规则会被合并为 3 到 10 条规则；来自不同批次的标题相同的规则会再次合并。 合并成一条规则所包含的候选规则数量即为该规则的支持度，其谓词也由 LLM 选择。 提示要求严格保留候选规则中出现的精确命令、搜索模式和路径，并拒绝将合并后的规则简化为“先复制”之类的建议。 技能学习 LLM 的界面仅会在以下情况中移除一条已合并的规则：该规则既未指定操作，也未陈述与文件路径或符号相关的明确事实，或者它与该仓库中已记录的惯例相矛盾。 n-gram 审计会标记任何文本与其来源问题之一参考补丁共享六个或更多连续词元的规则。

paragraphs.en: Selection uses two calls to the backbone LLM of A A . The first call receives the issue description, cut to 6,000 characters, and the titles of all rules, and returns a summary of the bug in two to three sentences and a list of the kinds of guidance that would help. The second call receives the issue description, that summary, and every rule with its identifier, tag, title, and body in z score order, and returns at most three rule identifiers with a one-line reason each. The system prompt of the second call asks for the rules most likely to help an engineer fix the bug. Identifiers that do not exist are discarded, and the selection may be empty. In our experiments, the rules shown to the two calls are the 36 transferable rules of S S ; Appendix C reports which of them were chosen.
paragraphs.zh: 选择过程会两次调用 A A 的基础 LLM。 第一次调用接收问题描述（截断至 6,000 个字符）和所有规则的名称，返回一个两到三句话的故障摘要，以及一份有助于解决问题的指导类型列表。 第二次调用接收问题描述、该摘要，以及每条规则按 z 分数排序后的标识符、标签、名称和正文，最多返回三个规则标识符，每个附带一行理由。 第二次调用的系统提示要求返回最有可能帮助工程师修复故障的规则。 不存在的标识符将被丢弃，因此选择结果可能为空。 在我们的实验中，提供给两次调用的规则是 S S 的 36 条可迁移规则；附录 C 报告了其中哪些规则被选中。

paragraphs.en: SWE-bench Pro issues are mined from public repositories, and the commit that fixed each issue is present in the public history of the repository, so an agent that can read that history or reach the network can copy the fix. We therefore build the container of every SWE-bench Pro issue in three steps. First, the repository is checked out at the base commit that the issue specifies. Second, the .git directory is deleted after the checkout, so git log , git diff , git show , and every other command that reads the history fail, and the agent sees only the files of the working tree. Third, the container is started without network access, so git fetch , curl , pip install , and any other command that reaches outside the container fail. The official evaluation images keep the history and the network, so resolution rates measured in them are not directly comparable to ours. Every method and backbone LLM in the paper runs in the same containers, so the comparison between methods is unaffected. DeepSWE tasks are authored for the benchmark rather than mined from public repositories, so no upstream fix exists to be found, and we run them in the official environment.
paragraphs.zh: SWE-bench Pro 的问题是从公开仓库中挖掘出来的，且修复每个问题的提交记录都存在于仓库的公开历史中，因此能够读取该历史记录或访问网络的智能体可以复制修复方案。 因此，我们以三个步骤构建每个 SWE-bench Pro 问题的容器。 首先，将仓库检出到问题所指定的基础提交版本。 其次，在检出后删除 .git 目录，这样 git log、git diff、git show 以及所有读取历史记录的其他命令都会失败，智能体只能看到工作树中的文件。 第三，启动容器时禁止网络访问，因此 git fetch、curl、pip install 以及任何试图访问容器外资源的命令都会失败。 官方评估镜像保留了历史记录和网络访问权限，因此其中测得的解决率无法直接与我们的结果进行比较。 论文中所有方法和基础 LLM 都在相同的容器中运行，因此方法之间的比较不受影响。 DeepSWE 任务是专为该基准测试设计的，而非从公开仓库中挖掘而来，因此不存在可查找的上游修复方案，我们在官方环境中运行这些任务。

paragraphs.en: The cost per issue reported in Section 4.1 is computed from the token counts recorded in the trajectory of each run and in the records of the calls made before the repair loop starts, namely the two selection calls of XRepoSkill and the three plan calls of STAIR. Every call is priced with the list price of its provider, in US dollars per million tokens. Input tokens are split into cache hits and cache misses, and each part is billed at the rate the provider charges for it: 0.003 and 0.15 for DeepSeek at the off-peak rate, 0.02 and 0.20 for GPT, whose cache writes are billed at 0.25, and 0.0036 and 0.435 for MiMo. Output tokens are billed at 0.60, 1.20, and 0.87, respectively. Table 5 lists the resulting cost per issue for every method, backbone LLM, and benchmark; the averages over backbone LLMs are the numbers quoted in Section 4.1 . The two selection calls of XRepoSkill cost $0.01 per issue with DeepSeek and GPT and $0.03 with MiMo, and the rest of its cost comes from the repair loop.
paragraphs.zh: 第 4.1 节中报告的每个问题的成本，是根据每次运行轨迹中记录的令牌数量以及修复循环开始之前所调用接口的记录计算得出的，即 XRepoSkill 的两个选择调用和 STAIR 的三个计划调用。 每次调用的定价均以其提供商的列表价格为准，单位为每百万令牌的美元。 输入令牌分为缓存命中和缓存未命中，每个部分均按提供商收取的相应费率计费：DeepSeek 在非高峰时段费率为 0.003 和 0.15，GPT 的费率为 0.02 和 0.20（其缓存写入费率为 0.25），MiMo 的费率为 0.0036 和 0.435。 输出令牌分别按 0.60、1.20 和 0.87 的费率计费。 表 5 列出了每种方法、基础 LLM 和基准测试对应的每个问题的成本；各基础 LLM 的平均值即为第 4.1 节中引用的数值。 XRepoSkill 的两个选择调用在使用 DeepSeek 和 GPT 时，每个问题的成本为 0.01 美元，使用 MiMo 时为 0.03 美元，其余成本则来自修复循环。

paragraphs.en: The main results place at most three rules in the prompt of each issue, and the second selection call of Stage 3 decides which. This section examines the selections made for the 939 combinations of an issue and a backbone LLM in the main results, recovered from the prompt of each run, and relates every transferable rule to the outcome on the combinations in which it was selected.
paragraphs.zh: 主要结果将每条问题的提示词中最多包含三条规则，而第 3 阶段的第二次选择调用会决定具体采用哪条。 本节分析了主要结果中针对每个问题与基础 LLM 的 939 种组合所做出的选择，这些选择是从每次运行的提示词中恢复得出的，并将每条可迁移的规则与其在相应组合中被选中时的结果关联起来。

sents.zh: 本节分析了主要结果中针对每个问题与基础 LLM 的 939 种组合所做出的选择，这些选择是从每次运行的提示词中恢复得出的，并将每条可迁移的规则与其在相应组合中被选中时的结果关联起来。

paragraphs.en: Figure 2 (a) shows the 19 transferable rules selected in at least 30 combinations. S0, reproduce the reported failure before touching source, was selected in 58.4% of the combinations and S5, inventory call sites and tests before modifying shared behavior, in 40.0%. The five most selected rules account for half of all selections and the top 11 for 80%. Of the other 17 rules, four were never selected and eight were selected fewer than ten times, so a third of the skill went almost unused. Part of this tail consists of rules that prescribe the same action as a frequent one in different words, for example, to read the tests before editing. Cross-repository generalization kept them apart because their predicates are true on different trajectories, and the selection call spreads its choices over them.
paragraphs.zh: 图 2(a) 展示了在至少 30 种组合中被选中的 19 条可迁移规则。 S0（在接触源之前重现已报告的故障）在 58.4% 的组合中被选中，而 S5（在修改共享行为之前检查库存调用站点和测试）则在 40.0% 的组合中被选中。 被选中次数最多的五条规则占所有选择的一半，而前 11 条规则则占 80%。 在其他 17 条规则中，有四条从未被选中，另有八条被选中次数少于十次，因此三分之一的技能几乎未被使用。 这些尾部规则中的一部分，用不同的措辞规定了与常用规则相同的操作，例如“在编辑之前阅读测试”。 跨仓库泛化使它们保持分离，因为它们的谓词在不同的轨迹上为真，而选择调用会将选择分布到这些轨迹上。

paragraphs.en: Figure 2 (b) shows, for the same 19 rules, the resolution rate of XRepoSkill minus that of mini-SWE-agent on the combinations in which the rule was selected. The difference is positive for 18 rules and zero for one, S4, and ranges from 2.9 to 14.3 percentage points; the two most selected rules, S0 and S5, gain 7.3 and 9.0 points on 548 and 376 combinations.
